column2: Nuestra Senora de la Etica Laxa
column3: South of Key Lento, off Abismo Key.
column4: 5 pieces. Golden Pendant inside central hull under smashed wood; Golden Chalice south of hull beside a crate; Ancient Snuff Box by mast under purple sea fan; Ceremonial Spoon southeast of wreck in sand; Battered Doubloon in a buried chest beyond the southern reef. Pull the chest free, then open it. Sell the complete set to Kenton.

column3: Dive marker south of Key Lento, closer to shore.
column4: 7 pieces. Dragon Pipe: south by mast, net and broken timber. Purple Gemstone: stern beside barrel. Antique Candlestick: south past mast by large anchor and barrels. Ivory Saint: north against hull. Pewter Gauntlet: north near bow. Serpentine Statue: below bow. Stained Doubloon: buried chest beyond stern, reported west of it; sweep both sides if needed. Sell all seven to Kenton.

column3: Island cluster southeast of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Ancient Ceremonial Mask: south of hull in seagrass. Sacred Necklace: southeast amid sand and pots. Golden Glove: east end by coral. Rusty Doubloon: south-side sand at midship. Ceremonial Plate: north against a coral-covered rock. Jade-Eye Cup: west side of bow. Search the tall hull ribs; sell all six to Kenton.

column3: Water southwest of the hooked islet, southeast of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Ceremonial Bowl: southeast stern, near coral-covered frame. Golden Llama: northeast among stones and crossed beams. Golden Statuette: north by front mast and fallen plank. Ceremonial Knife: bow rocks by low crossbeam. Shiny Doubloon: northwest by coral patch. Jade-Lobe Tankard: south hull rocks near broken pot. Sell the full set to Kenton.

column3: Farther offshore east of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Ornate Pocket Watch: remains of the stern at north end. Silver Hip Flask: east of hull by rocks and large broken panel. Brass Spyglass: west of bow at south end. Dividing Compass: west midship in debris and red sails. Santa Sierra Bell: northwest from red sails, by parallel timbers. Worn Doubloon: sand north of hull by coral-covered rock. Sell all six to Kenton.

column3: Off southern Belpoint, west of Bobcat Bight.
column4: 5 pieces at the deep-water dive site. 5 finds: Ancient Bracelet; Ancient Ingot; Avian Plate; Golden Fish; Lover's Grail. Kenton set; NOT one of 33 Underwater Discoveries.

column3: Reef off the west side of Bobcat Key.
column4: 6 pieces at the reef. 6 finds: Astrolabe; Captain's Whistle; Ceramic Pirate; Ivory Sundial; Naval Hourglass; Pirate's Buckle. Kenton set, NOT Underwater Discovery.
